title: The Three Cosmic Ages from Descent to Dissolution
description: The whole spiritual drama divided into three discrete ages: (1) the descent and return of the First Man, the longest and deepest labor; (2) the building and standing of the cosmos by the Living Spirit and the Mother of Life, the central and shortest age; and (3) the revealing work of the Third Ambassador down to the dissolution of the cosmos when Panaretos ascends. The relative magnitudes weigh the inmost hidden descent as greatest.
